title: Practice List
description: Practice List documentation for Super Admin.
overview: This guide covers practice list workflows for Super Admin.

subtasks.title: Browse & Search Practices
subtasks.purpose: Locate a specific practice from the master list.

steps.title: Open Practice List
steps.description: Open the Practice List (default landing view for Super Admin).

steps.title: Search by Practice Name
steps.description: Use the Search box to filter by practice name.

steps.title: Sort by Column
steps.description: Sort by clicking any column header (Status, Practice, Total Patients).

steps.title: Open Practice Detail
steps.description: Click the eye icon on a row to open the practice detail (see 6.2 onward).

subtasks.title: Open the Practice Tab
subtasks.purpose: Review a practice's primary contact and program dates.

subtasks.title: Manage Practice Admins
subtasks.purpose: See who administers the practice and add new admins.

steps.title: Review Practice Admins
steps.description: Review the list of existing practice admins.

steps.title: Add Practice Admin
steps.description: Click + Add Practice Admin to open the admin creation form.

steps.title: Save Admin Details
steps.description: Fill in name, email, phone, and role assignment; save.

subtasks.title: Manage Providers
subtasks.purpose: Maintain the clinician roster for the practice.

subtasks.title: Review Patients (CCM view)
subtasks.purpose: Inspect CCM patients enrolled at the practice.

subtasks.title: Review Patients (RPM view)
subtasks.purpose: Inspect RPM patients and latest vitals.

subtasks.title: Review System Caregivers Assigned to the Practice
subtasks.purpose: See which platform-level (System) caregivers currently serve the practice.

subtasks.title: Inspect RPM Program Detail
subtasks.purpose: View the RPM-specific enrollment window and contacts.

subtasks.title: Configure Schedule & Blood Pressure Targets
subtasks.purpose: Define the practice's daily schedule and per-window BP target ranges.

steps.title: Set Daily Schedule Times
steps.description: Set Wake-up, Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Bedtime times in the Daily Schedule.

steps.title: Set BP Target Ranges
steps.description: For each measurement window (Wake-up, Morning, Noon, Afternoon, Evening) set the target Systolic and Diastolic ranges.

subtasks.title: Bulk-Import Patients
subtasks.purpose: Enrollment is where new practices are provisioned on eVitals. A single scrollable form captures Practice Detail, Admin Detail, Practice Settings, and Care Program Billing Cycles.

steps.title: Open Import Patients Screen
steps.description: Open the Import Patients screen for the target practice.

steps.title: Select Provider
steps.description: Select the receiving Provider from the dropdown.

steps.title: Select Caregiver
steps.description: Select the receiving Caregiver from the dropdown.

steps.title: Upload Patient File
steps.description: Click Upload CSV/Excel and choose the prepared file.

steps.title: Import & Review Errors
steps.description: Click Import to run the upload; review any row-level errors returned.
